title: Excelente aplicación 🦋
body: Me gusta que registras tu progreso día por día. De esta forma, no hay ansiedad, pues te enfocas en un momento a la vez. Sin duda muy útil y recomendado para cambiar hábitos. Muchas gracias 🌹
author: lulu1329

title: Really useful and simple
body:
This app is pretty good, so simple yet helpful. Sometimes I struggle or forget to start things by my own but with this app i can keep track of my time and improve a bit everyday and eventually hope to make my habit as natural as possible

Thanks a lot, would recommend
author: GCQM
